lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value: Not an exhaustive catalogue of every dialog, resource, branch or device variant.
Real GNSS/device callback freshness, conditional autopan, lifecycle/rotation and field UI transitions were not executed.
Runtime permissions, tenant overlays, server policies and already stored projects need owner-specific acceptance.
Programmatic widgets have method evidence; XML declaration coverage is intentionally absent for them.
Desktop UI remains subject to the same provenance workflow, without a claim of a complete desktop UI catalogue.
Other locale/flavor/resource overlays outside the declared source/XML witnesses require fresh review; defaults and resource IDs alone do not prove effective runtime UI.
